1.title: YouTube just changed: What you need to know
1.author: Creator Insider
1.hook: YouTube CEO Neal Mohan announces platform changes at #MadeOnYouTube; Colin and Samir unpack implications with creators including MrBeast, MKBHD, and others.

1.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026: Dots, Spaces, and ULTRAFAST
1.author: How I AI
1.hook: First-hand testing of OpenAI's new APIs (Decisions, Astra ultrafast, Agents) with concrete demos (thumbnail selection, collaborative drawing, real-time 3D) and cost breakdowns ($97 for interactive experiments).

1.title: Jev: 8 real use cases this fast, cheap model
1.author: How I AI
1.hook: John Lindquist demos 8 concrete patterns for using Jev (a fast classification model) as a decision engine—router, deduplicator, multi-step classifier—with speed/cost benchmarks vs. full LLMs.

2.title: The Death of the Code Review: What the Data Actually Says — Laurie Voss, Arize AI
2.author: AI Engineer
2.hook: Autonomous agents write 741% more code but ship only 30% more software — human review is now the bottleneck, and the industry is rebuilding code review as a system rather than killing it.

3.title: Your Agents Are in Solitary Confinement: Why MCP & A2A Aren't Enough — Vlad Luzin, Band
3.author: AI Engineer
3.hook: Multi-agent systems require a distributed systems layer (transport, persistence, runtime binding, agent-first abstractions) — not just MCP or A2A — with live demos showing Codex, LangGraph, and Claude Code collaborating in real time.

1.title: The Chief AI Officer: Scientist, Architect, Coach — Rania Khalaf, WSO2
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Chief AI Officer role split into Scientist/Architect/Coach sliders with concrete metrics (AI fluency, agent-consumable products, MCP servers, agent-proof pricing) instead of token counting.

2.title: The State of AI in Software Development: Data from 400+ Orgs — Justin Reock, DX
2.author: AI Engineer
2.hook: Data from 200K engineers showing AI adoption patterns (juniors use most, staff+ save equivalent time on fewer tokens), code generation was never the bottleneck, and three named case studies (Morgan Stanley 300K hours/year, Zapier 15% value lift, Spotify SRE agent).

3.title: How Troye Sivan Became a Global Star On YouTube
3.author: Creator Insider
3.hook: Creator Insider interviews Troye Sivan on his creative process and fan connection strategy across YouTube.

1.title: Paddy Galloway Dives Deep on Video A/B & Ask Studio
1.author: Creator Insider
1.hook: YouTube VP discusses Video A/B testing, Dynamic Thumbnails, and Ask Studio — new creator tools with specific platform mechanics.
